basic_info.chief_complaint: Protruding teeth and gummy smile, consultation for correction

chief_complaint.chief_complaint: Protruding teeth and gummy smile, consultation for correction

oral_examination.oral_examination: Protruding face, retruded mandible, and high smile line. Bilateral canine molars have a neutral to mesial relationship. The front teeth open and bite 1-2mm, with shallow overjet.

source_handle: Explain the condition, keep the patient informed, ask for consideration, and choose a day for treatment.
